In Step 2, the agent presented specific data points (37% in 1995, 24% in 2025) as if retrieved from a web search, but these figures do not align with the actual historical data available from Girls Who Code or general CS statistics (which typically show a rise from ~20% in the 90s to ~26-27% recently, not a drop to 24% by 2025). This matches the pattern of "Over-Reliance on Summaries" and "Assumption of Data without Verification" seen in the reference examples.
